items.title: The Israeli military conducts airstrikes and artillery shelling across several regions of the Gaza Strip, killing at least 404 Palestinians and wounding 560 more. The shellings represent the largest attack of the Gaza war since the beginning of a ceasefire which came into effect on 19 January.
In Italy, the coronavirus death toll rises to 2,978. A total of 35,713 people have the virus in the country.
Federal Reserve rate decision: cut by 0.75 point, to a target of 2.25% (effective 2008-03-18)
